canDo: Can catch numbers, causes, changes, attitudes and implicit comparisons.
review: Review cause/contrast connectors as listening cues.
input: 3 sets of audio on work and social topics.
output: For each set: the gist + 3 details + the speaker’s attitude.
checkpoint: Sort mistakes into “numbers / negation / attitude / cause and effect”.
challenge: Today’s challenge: on TV5MONDE Apprendre’s B1 section, find a video about work or the workplace. Listen twice, then write 1 main idea + 3 details (numbers / causes / changes) + the speaker’s attitude (for / reserved / against); report one opinion each with selon lui… and il affirme que…, using at least 1 indefinite pronoun (chacun, certains, personne).

questions.why: « L'obstacle décisif n'est pas toujours technique »: it is often a matter of understanding administrative vocabulary.
He gives two examples: colleagues in other time zones and parents who go back to work at nine in the evening.
A quarter comes from sector and job; 4–5% is the part that can’t be explained.

V32-01.exZh: A rule that relies on individual goodwill often fails.

V32-02.zh: to share the assessment (of the situation)
V32-02.exZh: I share the assessment, not the solution.

V32-03.exZh: It’s clever, I admit it, but I have one worry.

V32-24.exZh: This hotel may suit a family perfectly.

V32-25.exZh: Moving administrative procedures online has brought real benefits.

V32-26.exZh: Keeping a counter open isn’t a transitional measure but a permanent guarantee.

V32-30.exZh: The second speaker is sceptical about switching off the servers.
